WITH m AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS mon, SUM(total_amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1), p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN amt END) AS aug_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-09' THEN amt END) AS sep_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-08' THEN cnt END) AS aug_count, MAX(CASE WHEN mon = '2026-09' THEN cnt END) AS sep_count FROM m) SELECT aug_amount, sep_amount, aug_count, sep_count, sep_amount - aug_amount AS change_amount, ROUND(CAST(((sep_amount - aug_amount) / NULLIF(aug_amount, 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percent FROM p LIMIT 100

WITH m AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS mon, SUM(total_amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT amt, cnt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-08'), s AS (SELECT amt, cnt FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-09') SELECT a.amt AS aug_amount, s.amt AS sep_amount, s.amt - a.amt AS change_amount, ROUND(CAST(((s.amt - a.amt) / NULLIF(a.amt, 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percent, a.cnt AS aug_count, s.cnt AS sep_count FROM a CROSS JOIN s LIMIT 100
